How we know

NCVC’s Rides page lists the Espresso Ride Sundays at 9:15 am (winter) or 8:45 am (summer) from High Road Cycling, Georgetown, 47.8 miles (read Oct 2, 2026; the page is undated).

Hosted by
National Capital Velo Club (NCVC)Club

For visitors

NCVC says coming along to its listed rides is the best way to introduce yourself, and that its Facebook and Instagram are the most up to date source; check there before a first visit. Wear a helmet and ride sensibly.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:45 am. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Not stated on the page.
Check
Look at @natcapveloclub the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the NCVC Espresso Ride group ride

NCVC Espresso Ride is a road group ride in Washington, DC. It rolls every Sunday at 8:45 am from High Road Cycling, Georgetown.

The National Capital Velo Club’s long Sunday road ride from Georgetown, 47.8 miles with 1,520 feet of climbing. The club’s team page lists it as a ride guests can join.
